summary: Parker-Hannifin filed an 8-K reporting completion on September 14, 2026 of registered senior note offerings totaling $2.4 billion (four USD tranches maturing 2028-2033) and €2.025 billion (three euro tranches maturing 2030-2036) under its Form S-3 shelf. Net proceeds, plus cash, repay borrowings under the December 10, 2025 364-day term loan with Barclays and other lenders used for the Filtration Group Corporation acquisition. Notes are senior unsecured, rank pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt, carry customary defaults and a 101% change-of-control put. Watch refinancing economics and leverage deleveraging; no equity deal terms.
